title: Tragic Sacrifices And A Shock Victory — Part 6
series_summary: Rick J-22 is tricked into a torture trap disguised as freedom, Slick Morty sacrifices himself into a fake wishing portal, and the assassin learns from prison that Candidate Morty survived and won the presidency.

cuts.voiceover_text: At the factory, the eccentric owner promises Rick J-22 full freedom and an escape portal. Rick surrenders in tears of relief. But it is a trap. Guards ambush him, strapping him down to harvest his fresh despair.

At the wishing portal, student Mortys realize it is just a garbage incinerator. Overcome by heartbreak, Slick Morty dives into the churning void, sacrificing himself. His friends stare in stunned sorrow.
In prison, the assassin discovers his bullets failed. Candidate Morty survived and swept the presidency in a historic landslide. The prisoner screams in horror. What monster has the Citadel elected?
